story_title_template: Jack and the Beanstalk starring [Child Name]
description: Jack and the Beanstalk storyboard for 1 cover, 12 story pages, and 1 tribute page.

pages.scene: Child as Jack in front of a giant beanstalk reaching into the clouds, small farmhouse and fields behind.
pages.text_template: Jack and the Beanstalk starring [Child Name]

pages.scene: Child and parent in a small, worn farmhouse, looking worried about an almost empty pantry and a few coins on the table.
pages.text_template: [Child Name] and [their] mother were running out of food on their little farm.

pages.scene: Child leading a gentle cow down a dirt road toward town, with fields and fences on either side.
pages.text_template: One morning, Mama asked [Child Name] to take their cow to market to sell.

pages.scene: A mysterious traveler on the roadside offering a handful of glowing beans, with the cow standing in the background.
pages.text_template: On the way, a strange man offered magic beans in exchange for the cow.

pages.scene: Child excitedly holding the beans while returning home, mother at the cottage door looking shocked and upset.
pages.text_template: [Child Name] traded the cow for the beans, but Mama was not impressed.

pages.scene: Inside the cozy farmhouse at evening, mother tossing the beans out of an open window while warm light glows behind her.
pages.text_template: She tossed the beans out the window, certain they were just useless seeds.

pages.scene: Outside view of the yard at night, the beans lying on the ground and softly glowing under the moon and stars.
pages.text_template: That night, the strange beans shimmered softly under the moonlight.

pages.scene: Morning scene with a gigantic beanstalk rising beside the house up into the clouds; child staring up in awe while the parent peeks from the doorway.
pages.text_template: By morning, a giant beanstalk had grown all the way up into the clouds.

pages.scene: Child climbing the beanstalk high above the ground, the tiny farm far below and fluffy clouds gathering around.
pages.text_template: Bravely, [Child Name] began to climb higher and higher toward the sky.

pages.scene: Cloud kingdom at the top of the beanstalk with a huge castle; child arriving at the massive doors or sneaking near the castle walls.
pages.text_template: At the top, [Child Name] found a giant’s castle hidden among the clouds.

pages.scene: Inside the great hall of the castle, a sleeping giant snoring in the background while the child sneaks toward a golden harp and a shining goose.
pages.text_template: Inside, a sleeping giant snored while golden treasures shimmered in the dark.

pages.scene: The giant waking and roaring, thundering after the child through the castle as the child races toward the beanstalk.
pages.text_template: When the giant woke up, he roared and thundered after [Child Name].

pages.scene: Child scrambling down the beanstalk; at the bottom, the parent chopping the stalk with an axe while the beanstalk begins to fall.
pages.text_template: [Child Name] reached the ground just in time, and Mama chopped the beanstalk down.

pages.scene: The family farm shown brighter and happier with a golden harp and/or goose nearby, the stump of the beanstalk visible. In the center, a warm portrait-style focus on the child inside a soft oval frame, surrounded by trees, sky, and colorful flowers.
pages.text_template: With the giant’s treasure, their little farm soon flourished. [Child Name] is a brave and imaginative young [boy/girl] whose kindness and courage shine in every adventure. Everyone who loves [Child Name] is very proud.
